remarks: This captivating haven at Saugatuck Shores, nestled along the pristine shores of Bermuda Lagoon, 100 feet of private beach and a deepwater dock-your perfect launchpad for unforgettable summer adventures or a warm winter escape. With soaring ceilings framing breathtaking water views, this open and airy oasis is ideal for year-round relaxation. Enjoy sunsets on the expansive wrap-around deck or cozy up inside by the fire as snow falls.  Indulge your inner chef in the gourmet kitchen, featuring an industrial stove, then gather around the marble table for meals with stunning views as your backdrop. The master suite is a true retreat with its own waterside deck, walk-in closets, and a luxurious bath complete with a Jacuzzi tub, shower, and double vanity. The main level includes three additional bedrooms, two with charming lofts perfect for younger guests.  On chillier days, head to the lower level family room with a cozy fireplace, or enjoy the 85-degree indoor 42ft pool, sauna, steam room, and gym-perfect for wellness and relaxation. Step outside to your private beach, where you can watch buffleheads dive, or swans and herons glide through the wetlands, a tranquil sight during snowy winter days.  Fully furnished and ready for you to customize, this waterfront gem offers the ultimate balance of nature, wellness, and beauty, whether it's summer or winter in Connecticut.
